“

A Modified Punisher shotgun firing heavy, high-damage slugs. Perfect for punching holes in big targets.

— Armory Description

The SG-8S Slugger is a Primary Shotgun, a variant of the standard Punisher that fires  Medium armor penetrating slugs, as opposed to buckshot. This means the shotgun acts more like a rifle, firing a single projectile per shot.

Procurement

The SG-8S Slugger is unlocked on the 8th page of the Helldivers Mobilize Warbond for 60 Medals.

Tactical Information

  • The slugger has  Medium armor penetration and is able to pierce Hive Guard heads, Bile Spewers, and Devastator torso armor.
  • Despite description, the slugger doesn't boast outstanding durable damage.
  • The Slugger can hold 16 shells in its magazine and carries up to 60 reserve shells, for a total combat load of 76 shells.
  • An Ammo box restores 30 reserve shells, and a Resupply box restores 60.
  • Unlike most other weapons, the SG-8S Slugger reloads one shell at a time, rather than reloading by magazine. This has advantages and disadvantages:
    • It takes 6.4 seconds to reload the entire 16 shell magazine.
    • Reloading can safely be done at any point, as there is no danger of wasting ammo by throwing away a partially filled magazine.
    • The reloading process may be interrupted at any time without losing any progress by firing the shotgun, switching weapons, diving, or interacting with any item. It will be ready to fire as long as it has 1 shell loaded.
    • Reloading any time the gun isn't being shot with will ensure that Helldivers will never run the tube empty
    • When reloading with exactly 8 rounds in the magazine, the final round count will increase by one round, making it 17 rounds. Moreover, every subsequent reload performed with 8 or more rounds remaining will result in a final count of 17 rounds, until the number of rounds in the magazine drops below 8.
  • The Slugger's slugs cause stagger. Which can be helpful for aggressive and fast enemies like Berserkers and Stalkers.
  • Due to its  Medium armor penetration and high damage, it is excellent at dispatching up to a medium amount of low to medium threats.
  • Because of its low rate of fire, it is recommended to bring alternative weapons that can handle crowds of smaller enemies, like the MG-43 Machine Gun or AX/AR-23 "Guard Dog". Though with good accuracy, it's still a somewhat decent horde-clearer.
  • While the First Person View, also known as ADS (Aim Down Sights), is useful for long range precision shots, the third person view is recommended for close range encounters due to the superior handling. Be mindful that the slug fired by the shotgun has a lot of drag, so more rounds will be required to put down a target at range.
  • Shots can penetrate through a single light-armored body part, allowing for multiple kills with one shot to be possible.

Trivia

  • The SG-8S Slugger has a unique reloading animation, where the Helldiver can be seen loading shells into the magazine from the left- and right-side bandoleers attached to the shotgun. This can also be seen in first-person.
  • Both the Slugger and SG-20 Halt are the only shotguns to feature rifled barrels for better projectile velocity and accuracy.
  • The appearance of the SG-8S, like all Punisher variants, is loosely based on the UTS-15.
